note: Two stages, and the order matters: hue=s=0.25 first strips the original colour down to near-monochrome, THEN colorbalance paints brown back in. Tinting without stripping first leaves the source colours fighting the sepia and gives muddy results. Measured SATAVG 39.1 -> 15.0 with everything sitting on the red-yellow side (input 128 -> 149,131,117).
